reads.L0: EEG [0, post): the lag_local_tokens full window (post-only)
reads.L1: EEG [-pre, post): the same encoder recipe on the query-aligned window
reads.SC local_only: the base's input only (ridge on the base output u)
reads.SC local_refit_capacity: the base's input only (ridge on u + the base encoder's own tokens)
reads.SC aligned_pretrained / aligned_random: the base's input + frozen FM tokens of [-pre, post)
reads.SC small_context: the base's input + the raw window [-pre, post)
reads.SC concat: the base's input + pretrained FM tokens of [-pre, post) (joint ridge)
reads.RS (every variant): L0's input + a context branch on [-pre, post) (FM tokens or a small conv)

access.source: complement32.Featurizer (u, tok on bt.patches; raw / FM on masked_windows(E, e, -pre, post)); residual32.Rows; record fields

SC_code.pca: torch.pca_lowrank (randomised, niter = 4) per block tok / raw / fm_pretrained / fm_random
SC_code.training_rows: fit + es segments of the outer-fold training participants (complement32.run: units = fit + es)
SC_code.alpha_selection: grouped CV over the 5 participant groups (correlation), residual ridges on out-of-fold base predictions

RS_code.training_rows: fit segments of training participants outside group 0
RS_code.development: <= 300 fit + es segments of group 0 (training participants)
RS_code.dev_temperature: <= 300 es segments outside group 0, against their own pool
RS_code.selection: lowest development risk over epochs 0..E (epoch 0 = the base)

evaluator.readout_rows: all grid anchors of fit + es segments of the outer-fold training participants
evaluator.unified_alpha_selection: fit rows -> es rows, mean per-dimension correlation; refit on fit + es rows
evaluator.native_NCE: fixed dot product u . v (no fitted parameter)
evaluator.calibration: one temperature per readout on training es queries against the es candidate pool
evaluator.test: all single-speaker test segments of the fold's test participants on the dense grid; candidates = unique test stimuli

record_field.name: epoch0_max_abs_diff_vs_base
record_field.where: residual32.fit_residual at epoch 0: one training-side batch (N_SEG segments of training-fit participants x Q anchors), max |normalise(u_base + r) - u_base| with the zero-initialised last layer; not measured on the outer test

SC.saved: per-identity evaluations of the six variants; ridge alphas and grouped-CV curves; PCA means and bases (ckpt)
SC.not_saved: ridge coefficients (closed-form; a refit with the saved PCA bases and alphas needs the training rows' features again, FM forwards for the FM variants); per-query predictions; FM / raw features

RS.saved: per-identity evaluation at the selected epoch; dev curve per epoch (risk, rank, temperature, train loss); selected-epoch trainable weights (residual head + context LayerNorm/Linear or small conv; frozen encoder / backbone excluded)
RS.epoch0: no unit has a separate epoch-0 file: residual32 writes epoch 0 to <eid>_best.pt first and overwrites it when a later epoch has lower development risk; for the units that selected epoch 0 the single file is the epoch-0 state (zero last layer, see the checkpoint layer); for every other unit epoch 0 is reconstructed exactly (zero last layer -> r = 0)
RS.not_saved: intermediate epochs (resume file removed at completion); per-query outputs; the random-init backbone weights (regenerated from torch.manual_seed(seed) + Backbone(random_full); checked by the development-only runs listed under the engineering checks and by each unit's own reproduction check)

asset_audit.files_by_id_search: file names containing an experiment id (regex ALN3X?_<16 hex>) under results/auditory_alignment_v3 and private/auditory_alignment_v3

gpu_plan.basis: assumed, not measured: per unit 1.25 x the record's eval_seconds + 90 s (range 1.0 x + 60 s to 1.6 x + 120 s)
